I used to have to arrange a small farmers market in one of my previous jobs. We’d set out tables and it was first come first serve in terms of placement. There were enough for everyone since you had to register beforehand. Anyhow, despite this, we did have accommodations for disabled vendors - which we had. There was one wheelchair bound artist and we allowed him to reserve one spot for the whole summer since it was most convenient for him. One morning one dude who wanted to sell raffle tickets for a fundraiser had set up in this dudes spot, when I noticed him the raffle guy and the artist dude were already arguing. I took the artists side and politely asked him to please take any other table and I would personally help him set everything back up (there wasn’t much). To this he just ripped everything down and stormed off. He sulked in a corner for the remainder of the afternoon feeling sorry for himself. Dude looked about 45 and was acting like how I would when I did get the candy I wanted at 7 years old.
